request.description: With ?replacementCategoryId=<same-type category>, the category's transactions AND debts are reassigned to the replacement before it's deleted. Without it, the request is rejected (400) if any transaction still uses the category; debts alone don't block it — they keep existing with categoryId = null.

request.description: If the transaction was generated for a debt installment (description "Parcela n/N - <debt name>"), that installment is paid (paymentDate = today) or unpaid to match and its debt's totals/status are recomputed, atomically. The response is still just the transaction — refetch GET /debts/:id to see the installment.

request.description: If the transaction is linked to a debt installment, the installment is kept and its transactionId becomes null; paying it later (POST /debts/:id/installments/:installmentId/pay) creates a fresh linked transaction.
Debt installments linked to any deleted transaction are kept with transactionId = null (same as Delete Transaction).
